why: The handler that paints instead of persisting. The label moves under the finger so it looks like it worked, and nothing else happens at all: the preset is not saved, so it dies with the tab, and no session ever reads it -- which for this setting means the muzzle smoke the player is trying to switch off keeps drawing, match after match. The store is the only thing a settings handler is allowed to touch, and this is the mutation that says why.
